Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ride the Trend add-ons enforced live: session cumulative delta, spread proxy, volume-profile nodes

(A) Session delta from per-minute aggregates with a decision-time cutoff, feed generations restart at a
reconnect or gap, partial totals labeled, 30 minutes of continuous feed and trade delivery to the cutoff
required. (B) Spread proxy: spread in force at the start of each second carried forward, last 10 s vs the
trailing 30-minute median, gate 1.5x and 30 bps; crossed quotes invalidate classification, spread and book
until a valid quote; locked markets ignored. (C) Volume profile of the five prior sessions from 1-minute
bars (overlap-weighted 0.1% buckets, nodes >= 1.5x median), support under the pullback extreme and a clear
road to the first target (shared executable stop/target helper), profiles fetched from the relay with
generations, bounds and a worker-thread build; card shows per-symbol readiness and last block reason.
All three enforced from day one (RIDE_THE_TREND_ADDONS_ENFORCED). Codex plan attack (21) and code review
(30, 10 P0) fixed and triaged in docs/ride_the_trend_v2/. 1,132 tests green; four real replays pass.

Ride the Trend data layers part 2: raw print store, real-time delta measures, regime ETF feed (recorded, promotable)

Layer 1: per-second raw print store (packed columns, whole-second eviction, coverage on every query,
quote-history classification of late prints, trade-id de-duplication, ineligible conditions excluded).
Layer 3: impulse, pullback, resumption and rolling-30-minute delta plus velocity and book recorded on
every resumption evaluation from one complete-and-finite snapshot; gates only when named in
RIDE_THE_TREND_ENFORCED_GATES. Layer 4: RegimeFeed for XLK/XLC/XLY/XLF/UUP/SHY/IEF (bars only),
sector direction and relative return, dollar and rates wind, recorded at decision time and in admission.
Quote-classified floor set from the live feed (25-51% of volume prints at the inside).

Two Codex code-review rounds (34 + 7 findings) drove the per-second redesign, completeness on every
gate, admissibility before mutation, atomic re-sort, outage intervals and regime hardening; reviews and
triage in docs/ride_the_trend_v2/. 1,127 tests green; three real mornings plus an all-arms run replayed
with all seven ETF streams (0 signals, invariants held); step-0 funnel diagnostics for the operator.

Ride the Trend v2: four required data layers, fail-closed gates, trail-only runner (not yet deployed)

Replaces the vwap_pullback strategy with a deterministic VWAP-structure machine gated by
Layer 1 tick aggression (SIP prints classified at bid/ask), Layer 2 top-of-book imbalance,
Layer 3 velocity on exchange nanosecond stamps, and Layer 4 regime (SPY/QQQ, VIX, relative
strength, macro blackout calendar). Stop computed once (stop_is_final), 1R half + trail-only
runner, mornings only, TSLA/CDE/SPY/QQQ excluded, state rebuilt safely after restarts.

Evidence: 59 new tests (1,121 total green), real-tick dry runs of 3 sessions through the live
handlers (0 signals, all invariants held, coexists with the other arms), a full fake session
through main proving entry -> bracket -> T1 -> trail -> stop and the 15:55 flatten. Codex code
review (34 findings, 8 P0) fixed and triaged in docs/ride_the_trend_v2/. Stale plan files
archived under docs/plans_archive/. Push held for the operator's decision.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Research: Ride the Trend (vwap_pullback) has no edge; 50-hypothesis backtest 2024-2026

Parity-proven 1-min replay of the live rules on the 12 watchlist symbols:
4,407 trades, mean R -0.055 (SE 0.013), +0.001 with zero cost; forward drift
after 36k signals is 0 bps at every horizon. 69 rule variants found nothing
positive across IS/VAL/HOLD. Recommendation: turn the strategy off. No bot
code changed.

Add Tesla + Coeur Morning Plan (tri-engine) as live paper arms

Implements /Users/mo/multi_stock_edge_lab_3yr/EXECUTION_PLAN.md as two
fixed-rule arms on the Alpaca paper account, no shadow period:
tsla_asymmetric_dual (half 1.5R/180m, half 2R/240m, one OCO per half) and
cde_asymmetric_dual (2R/180m). The old OR15 arm takes no new entries.

Operator decisions: market entries at T+2 for both sides (the plan's
numbers come from a T+2 raw-open fill), TSLA first come first served
with the older arms, 09:30-09:44 opening range as written, plan orders
sized by 0.75% stop risk without the $25k cap (it refused 92 of 146 real
2026 TSLA trades). Daily loss stop is min($1,500, 2.5% of session-start
equity) and survives restarts.

Finding: the research behind the plan's win rates built its range and
QQQ VWAP from 04:00 pre-market bars. With that quirk emulated the live
signal code matches the research on 565/565 TSLA days; as written, TSLA
2R and CDE backtest as not significant. Details in
docs/tri_engine/EVIDENCE.md.

Fixed from reviews: Codex E1-E6; save on every quote; lost entry reply
forgetting broker shares; transient 429/5xx closing trades; request
bursts; feed reconnect flattening; transient partial fills killing
trades; stuck-cancel partials left unprotected; missing Dockerfile copy
of the frozen source (startup would have failed on Railway).

Verified: backend 773 passed (1 pre-existing date-bound swing test fails
on HEAD too), dry run 29/29, real-day handler replay 145/146 TSLA and
178/178 simulable CDE exits equal to the research simulator, old-to-new
checkpoint upgrade, dashboard 7 states at desktop and phone width.
